About.subtitle: About Proyecta Tu Viaje
About.title: Your local connection to memorable experiences in La Fortuna
About.paragraph1: Proyecta Tu Viaje helps travelers discover and request reservations for carefully selected tours in La Fortuna, Costa Rica.
About.paragraph2: Our goal is to make the process easier and more personal. You choose the experience, send your preferred date and time, and we verify availability directly with the local operator.
About.paragraph3: Once availability is confirmed, you receive the reservation details and the conditions for payment directly associated with the selected tour.
About.bottomDescription: Horseback riding, zipline adventures, nature walks, coffee tours and other authentic Costa Rican experiences.
About.value1Description: We help you choose an experience according to your interests, schedule and travel plans.
About.value2Description: Reservation requests are coordinated with experienced tour operators in the La Fortuna area.
About.value3Description: You receive availability confirmation and the important details before attending the activity.

FAQ.subtitle: Frequently Asked Questions
FAQ.title: Everything you need to know before requesting a tour
FAQ.description: Find answers about reservations, payments, cancellations, schedules, weather and communication with our team.

benefits.directPayment: Pay the local operator on the tour day

reservation.question: How do I request a reservation?
reservation.answer: Choose the tour you are interested in, complete the reservation form with your preferred date and time, and submit your request. We will confirm availability directly with the local operator.

confirmation.question: Is my reservation confirmed immediately?
confirmation.answer: No. Your request remains pending until we verify availability with the local tour operator and send you a confirmation message.

payment.question: When do I pay for the tour?
payment.answer: You do not pay Proyecta Tu Viaje anything in advance. Payment is made directly to the local tour operator on the day of the tour, according to the payment methods accepted by the operator.

noAdvancePayment.question: Why doesn't Proyecta Tu Viaje charge in advance?
noAdvancePayment.answer: Our purpose is to connect travelers with trusted local tour operators in La Fortuna. By paying the operator directly on the day of the activity, you can reserve without making an advance payment through our website and enjoy greater flexibility when planning your trip.

weather.question: What happens if it rains?
weather.answer: Many tours operate normally in light rain. If weather conditions are unsafe, the local operator may reschedule or cancel the activity according to the applicable safety conditions.

cancellation.question: Can I cancel my reservation?
cancellation.answer: Yes. You can cancel your reservation free of charge. We kindly ask you to notify us at least 24 hours before the scheduled start of the tour so we can inform the local operator and make the space available to other travelers.

contact.question: Can I contact you by WhatsApp or email?
contact.answer: Yes. You can contact us directly by WhatsApp or email if you would like personalized assistance before submitting your reservation request.
